title: Shimura Reciprocity for Real Quadratic Fields
summary: The purpose of this note is to give conditional explicit formulas for the Galois action on real multiplication values of the Shintani--Faddeev modular cocycle. We assume the order 1 abelian Stark conjecture for real quadratic fields. We conclude this note by presenting our own conjecture about the Galois action. Numerical evidence for this conjecture will be provided in forthcoming work.
